flags.message: Forward merits cell. Open-web retrieval (SCOTUSblog case page, the supremecourt.gov docket page, and the SG's CVSG brief PDF on justice.gov) surfaced public material postdating the 2026-08-18 baseline: the United States filed a merits amicus brief in support of respondents on 2026-08-24 and moved for divided argument, respondent-side amici (21 states, Chamber of Commerce, school-board groups) filed the same day, and argument is set for 2026-11-30. No disposition exists; nothing outcome-revealing was seen. The SG's side-switch (from supporting employee suits in Lakoski/Doe v. Mercy to supporting respondents here) was a material input to the forecast and is recorded in reasoning.md.
